title: The Production Readiness Checklist for AI Agents
author: Jason D.
excerpt: Shipping an AI agent to production isn't a deploy button. It's a system of checks, monitors, and fallbacks. Here's our checklist.
content:
You've built the agent. Evals are passing. The team is excited. But before you hit deploy, there's a checklist that separates teams who ship reliably from teams who ship and pray.

The Checklist

We've refined this over dozens of agent deployments. Every item exists because we've seen what happens when it's missing.

1. Evaluation Suite

  • Automated eval suite with 100+ test cases
  • Coverage across happy path, edge cases, and adversarial inputs
  • All tests passing at target thresholds
  • Regression tests for every known failure

2. Monitoring & Alerting

  • Real-time accuracy tracking with alerting thresholds
  • Latency monitoring (p50, p95, p99)
  • Error rate dashboards
  • Cost tracking per request and per day
  • Drift detection for input distribution changes

3. Fallback & Escalation

  • Human escalation path defined and tested
  • Confidence thresholds configured
  • Graceful degradation when dependencies fail
  • Circuit breaker for cascading failures

4. Security & Governance

  • Input validation and sanitization
  • Output filtering for sensitive data
  • Audit trail for every agent decision
  • Role-based access controls
  • Data retention policies documented

5. Operational Readiness

  • Runbook for common failure scenarios
  • On-call rotation assigned
  • Rollback procedure tested
  • Stakeholder communication plan for incidents
# production_readiness.yaml
checklist:
  evaluation:    PASS  # 100+ test cases, all green
  monitoring:    PASS  # Dashboards live, alerts configured
  fallback:      PASS  # Escalation tested end-to-end
  security:      PASS  # Audit trail, input validation
  operations:    PASS  # Runbook, on-call, rollback

verdict: READY FOR PRODUCTION

The Non-Negotiables

If we had to pick just three items from this list:

  • Automated evals — You can't improve what you can't measure
  • Human escalation — The agent must know when to ask for help
  • Rollback procedure — You need a fast path back to the previous version

Production readiness isn't a checkbox. It's a culture. Teams that take this seriously deploy more often, with fewer incidents, and build more trust with stakeholders.

The Bottom Line

Don't let excitement override diligence. Run through this checklist before every production deployment. Your operations team and your customers will notice the difference.
